name: Muscle-up
description: A pull above a bar that turns into a dip on top of it. High pulling, straight-bar pressing and the transition are trained separately before joining them.

steps.label: Pull-up
steps.cue: Full hang at the bottom, chin over the bar at the top.

steps.label: Straight bar dip
steps.cue: Lean over the bar and lock your arms at the top.

steps.label: Chest to bar pull-up
steps.cue: Pull your elbows down behind you until your chest meets the bar.

steps.label: Band assisted muscle-up
steps.cue: Keep the bar close and lean your chest over it early.

steps.label: Muscle-up negative
steps.cue: Take five seconds or more through the transition.

steps.label: Strict muscle-up
steps.cue: Pull to your lower chest, then roll your wrists over fast.
